Universe’26 · Section 3 · Final exercise

Attach a cheat sheet artifact

Use the /create-issue-artifact skill to attach a cheat sheet of the top Virtual Universe updates to an issue.

4 min · 2 steps
Issue Artifacts attach plans, notes, design docs, images and links directly to a GitHub issue, so important context doesn’t get lost in comments.
Setting up your issue…
Finding your fork of octodemo/virtual-universe-26 → turning issues on → opening "My GitHub Universe '26 cheat sheet" → opening a session linked to it.

Switch to the new session when it opens. This guide opens there too, ready for step 1.

  1. Run the skill

    In the new issue session, run:

    Copilot chat · issue session
    /create-issue-artifact follow github-virtual-universe-highlights/attach-a-cheat-sheet-artifact/instructions.md

    In about a minute Copilot adds the cheat sheet and a How Copilot built this artifact with its working notes to your issue, then opens the Badge Simulator with a surprise on your badge.

  2. Share your badge

    Press Share to save a GIF of your Virtual Universe badge to your Downloads folder and post it with the hashtag #virtualuniverse26 to connect with the rest of the virtual community 🧑🏿‍🚀. Keep playing in the online badge simulator.

🎉 That’s the end of the workshop. Thanks for building with us! See the Universe recap for more.
